overview: The Mystic Valley Development Commission failed to reach a quorum and tabled the meeting. No official business was conducted.

items.title: Notice of Meeting and Remote Participation
items.summary: The notice of the meeting and state provisions for remote participation were read into the record.

items.title: Roll Call and Adjournment
items.summary: The meeting was tabled until a future date because only one member was present, failing to meet the required quorum.
